title: workspaces show screen number on screen image at top of editor

judgment.rationale: The author confirms that the monitor numbers in Workspaces do not match Windows display numbering and asks for visible labels under each monitor preview. A maintainer explained that app lists are grouped by screen number to keep the preview uncluttered. This is a UI clarity enhancement, not a functional defect or a request requiring a code fix.
evidence: The original report uses Workspaces 0.84.0 with three displays and asks to show screen numbers above or below the preview images.
A maintainer asked whether the app-list numbers matched Windows display numbers and explained the intent to avoid cluttering the preview.
The author replied that Workspaces numbers did not match Windows numbering and that the main issue was difficulty mapping screen numbers to the thumbnails.
The author explicitly described matching Windows numbering as optional, 'icing on the cake'.
judgment.recommended_action: Retain as a low-priority UI enhancement for product/design prioritization; no bug-fix proposal is warranted.

fix_assessment.rationale: The requested monitor labels are an enhancement to clarify an existing UI and do not represent a demonstrated malfunction.

issue_context.summary: The Workspaces editor previews three monitors but does not label the thumbnails, and its screen IDs do not match Windows display numbering.
known_information: The issue was reported on Workspaces 0.84.0 with a laptop and two docked displays; the author also uses Duet with an iPad display.
The author wants a label under each image so the image-to-screen association is clear.
A maintainer noted that the app list below the preview is already separated by Workspaces screen number.
The author confirmed Workspaces IDs 9, 10, and 1 did not correspond to Windows display IDs 2, etc.
inferences: Consistent numbering with Windows may be helpful, but the author says it is optional; the primary ask is a visible association between preview and Workspaces screen ID.
The report is an enhancement request and does not establish that workspace launch or placement is incorrect.
issue_context.analysis: No information request or implementation proposal is needed. This should be prioritized as a UX improvement if monitor identification remains confusing to users.
initial_investigation: Read the full live body and both comments, including the maintainer's explanation and author's clarification.
Checked Workspaces screen identity/display preview ownership; no functional defect is alleged.
